content.title: BL Q2 Deep Dive: Strategic Shift to Larger Deals and Platform Expansion Drives Mixed Results
content.summary: Accounting automation software maker Blackline (NASDAQ:BL) reported Q2 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.2% year on year to $172 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $178 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.61 per share was 19.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
